name: When should I hire a professional for drywall repair instead of doing it myself?

mainEntity.name: When should I hire a professional for drywall repair instead of doing it myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small cosmetic nail holes can usually be filled and painted by a homeowner with basic spackle. Professional repair is recommended for large holes, stress cracks along framing seams, ceiling damage, or water-damaged drywall. Improper repairs often leave noticeable bulges, visible seams, or uneven textures. A professional matches wall textures, re-secures loose framing or backing boards, and blends primer and paint so the patch integrates seamlessly with the surrounding wall.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a professional for holes larger than a few inches, ceiling damage, water-softened boards, or walls requiring blended texture matching.
